## DinoBloom

A ViT (Vision Transformer) built upon DINOv2 (Meta AI) and trained on data of single cells from peripheral blood and bone marrow.

- **Project:** `dinobloom`
- **Capabilities:** `embed`
- **Input:** images
- **Platforms:** linux-x86_64, macos-arm64
- **Citation:** <https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.05022>

| Variant | Parameters | Model card |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `b` | 86M | [virtual-human-chc/DinoBloom](https://huggingface.co/virtual-human-chc/DinoBloom) |
| `g` | 1.1B | [virtual-human-chc/DinoBloom](https://huggingface.co/virtual-human-chc/DinoBloom) |
| `l` | 304M | [virtual-human-chc/DinoBloom](https://huggingface.co/virtual-human-chc/DinoBloom) |
| `s` | 22M | [virtual-human-chc/DinoBloom](https://huggingface.co/virtual-human-chc/DinoBloom) |

```python
import vhmodels

model = vhmodels.load_model(project="dinobloom", model="b")
```

## HOptimus0

H-Optimus-0 extracts 1536-dimensional features from H&E histology tiles with a 1.1B-parameter vision transformer.

- **Project:** `hoptimus0`
- **Capabilities:** `embed`
- **Input:** images
- **Platforms:** linux-x86_64
- **Citation:** <https://github.com/bioptimus/releases/tree/main/models/h-optimus/v0>
- **Access:** gated on Hugging Face; request access on the model card and log in with `hf auth login`

| Variant | Parameters | Model card |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default` | 1.1B | [bioptimus/H-optimus-0](https://huggingface.co/bioptimus/H-optimus-0) |

```python
import vhmodels

model = vhmodels.load_model(project="hoptimus0")
```

## Hyformer

A joint transformer-based model that unifies a generative decoder with a predictive encoder.

- **Project:** `hyformer`
- **Capabilities:** `embed`
- **Input:** sequences
- **Platforms:** linux-x86_64
- **Citation:** <https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.16559>

| Variant | Parameters | Model card |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hyformer_molecules_50M` | 50M | [virtual-human-chc/hyformer_molecules_50M](https://huggingface.co/virtual-human-chc/hyformer_molecules_50M) |
| `hyformer_molecules_8M` | 8M | [virtual-human-chc/hyformer_molecules_8M](https://huggingface.co/virtual-human-chc/hyformer_molecules_8M) |
| `hyformer_peptides_34M` | 34M | [virtual-human-chc/hyformer_peptides_34M](https://huggingface.co/virtual-human-chc/hyformer_peptides_34M) |

## MolE

MolE learns task-independent molecular representations of chemicals via Graph Isomorphism Networks (GINs).

- **Project:** `mole`
- **Capabilities:** `embed`, `predict`
- **Input:** file
- **Platforms:** linux-x86_64, macos-arm64
- **Citation:** <https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-025-58804-4>
